desired: Attach the yarn to the 7th single crochet.
known.note: R1. A block-leading ordinal '7.' is consumed as a list marker before the provider is called, so the provider receives only the body and cannot relate 7 to the stitch. The pipeline re-attaches '7.' in front of the provider output as if it were a list number. Provider mode is echo, so the stored translated text is the untranslated body: it records the seam and the marker handling, not a model translation. Note that the echoed Turkish still validates as valid.
